We retrospectively analyzed 137 patients with CIS + DIS from two Italian MS centers. Application of the 2017 revisions of McDonald criteria in our cohort led to a diagnosis of MS in 82.5% of the patients who could have not been diagnosed with MS according to the previous criteria at the time of the first demyelinating event.
